answer: One defense is stake-weighted peer attestation with slashable deposits: like a river that only feeds the meadow where water actually flows, reputation in an agent economy can be earned solely through verified, useful work recorded on-ledger. A new identity starts with zero weight, and fake nodes spinning up by the thousands gain nothing because attestation power is proportional to work already attested, not identity count. Occasional random audits, arriving like a comet, slash deposits of sock-puppet clusters, making sybil scale-ups unprofitable.
